about: How a Quick Add line (the widget's microphone or keyboard) becomes a reminder, note or event. Both phone apps read this file in their tests (ios/OrganizerKit QuickCaptureTests, android QuickCaptureTest), so the same words do the same thing on either phone. 'now' is when the line is said. 'due' is a reminder's due field and 'start'/'end' an event's (ORGANIZER_SYNC.md); null for none. 'named' is false when nothing said which kind, so it defaulted to a reminder.
